name: Legends YouTube
summary: Unified YouTube Data API v3, Analytics API v2, Studio packaging, and verified yt-dlp media archiving CLI: 2-unit channel inventory, 0-quota outlier and public readback radar, Perfect Video Score idea scoring, lossless ETag-guarded metadata updates, SHA-256 frozen private-draft uploads, anonymous yt-dlp capture and ffprobe stream verification, GPU word ledgers and FFmpeg clip plans, and an 18-file Empire knowledge pack.
outcomes: Inventory YouTube channels via relatedPlaylists.uploads for 2 quota units per 50 videos and calculate multi-day batch waves against the 10,000-unit daily pool and 2026-06-01 granular caps
Execute lossless, ETag-guarded (If-Match) videos.update metadata mutations with SHA-256 plan locks, preflight drift verification, full snippet field preservation, and post-write readback verification
Verify public video playability, metadata, and oEmbed status for 0 quota units and 0 credentials via public-readback, and scout channel outlier velocity via 0-quota RSS feeds
Probe channel and playlist metadata into a reviewable items.jsonl ledger before downloading, enforce anonymous no-cookie yt-dlp.conf SHA-256 allowlists, and verify every media stream with ffprobe
Demux audio for local GPU Parakeet ASR (CrispASR) and NeMo Forced Aligner word ledgers, search exact spoken phrases, render frame-accurate FFmpeg clip plans, and export Obsidian transcript vaults

Score pre-recording video candidates with the Perfect Video Score formula, benchmark CTR/APV/mid-roll metrics against dated YouTube Help thresholds, and correlate retention curves with spoken transcript lines

Validate YouTube description chapters, Studio video quizzes (ytve-posts-modal), custom PNG/JPEG thumbnails (<= 2 MB), Shorts Related-video isolation guards, and SHA-256 frozen private-draft resumable uploads
examples: Inventory my YouTube channel and generate a lossless metadata plan to migrate legacy description links without wiping video tags
Probe a channel into an items.jsonl ledger with yt-dlp, run anonymous SHA-256 config preflight, pull the batch, verify streams with ffprobe, and extract GPU word-timed clips
Calculate the YouTube Data API v3 quota cost and daily waves needed to update 250 video descriptions
Run a channel health scorecard and rank below-median-CTR long-form videos for Title and Thumbnail Test & Compare A/B runs
Validate my video description chapters, Studio video quizzes JSON, and custom thumbnail before freezing a private draft upload
exclusions: Do not call PUT /youtube/v3/videos?part=snippet without merging existing live snippet fields (title, description, tags, categoryId, defaultLanguage, defaultAudioLanguage)
Do not use search.list to inventory a channel's uploads when relatedPlaylists.uploads is available
Do not read browser profile databases, cookie stores, or system credential stores for YouTube authentication or yt-dlp capture
